patch.summary: Foxit implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement Foxit by mapping current project-management workflows to Foxit objects, confirming plan gates for premium capabilities, piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (Microsoft 365, Google Drive, Dropbox) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: confirm paid unlocks before go-live
Integrate after: data quality pass on Microsoft 365

blocks.heading: Foxit day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat Foxit setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for automations and workflows, docs and collaboration before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves Teams needing PDF edit/convert/sign as adjacent productivity before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate Microsoft 365 and Google Drive before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover must-have capabilities
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Adjacent tool — not a project management or work OS platform
Do not expand seats until automations and workflows is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: Adjacent tool — not a project management or work OS platform

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: No task boards, Gantt, workload or PM dashboards as the primary product

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: Scored low on work-planning by design for category fairness

items.title: Mistake 4
items.body: AI document features are limited vs dedicated AI writing suites

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: Foxit plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.
